Birthday Party Bash.name: Birthday Party Bash
Birthday Party Bash.summary:
Birthday parties will never be the same with Birthday Party Bash!

Up to 12 partygoers can whack, roll, splash, pop, and shimmy their way through over 20 birthday games, including twists on classic favorites like Piñata Blast, Duncan Hines Cake Stacker, and Birthday Blowout. Ten party theme rooms set the scene for an unforgettable bash, from “Pirates” to “Princess”. When it’s cake time, everyone can sing along to “Happy Birthday.” Free party invitations included in the box!

The game comes with 12 Birthday Party Invitations in the box, a great "buy one get one free" coupon or the party sweets and the manual doubles as a party planning tool with party tips, recipes and more!

Up to 12 players can play via 4 player turn-based play.

Chuck E. Cheese's Party Games.name: Chuck E. Cheese's Party Games
Chuck E. Cheese's Party Games.summary: WHERE A KID CAN BE A KID! Rock out on stage with Chuck, race trucks with Jasper, make pizzas with Pasqually and more! Play your favorite arcade games, earn tickets and collect prizes to deck out your own special room. Fun for the whole family, this title is fit for any kid, any age, any day!

Doctor Who - Return to Earth.name: Doctor Who: Return to Earth
Doctor Who - Return to Earth.summary:
The Doctor and Amy arrive on the deserted starship the Lucy Gray, which was the first ship to return to earth after the solar storms of the 26th century. However, on the ship are the Daleks and Cybermen, who are after the dangerous Time Axis. The Doctor and Amy must prevent them from obtaining it.

The game is written by Doctor Who writer Oli Smith and features Matt Smith and Karen Gillan providing voices for their characters.

Rapala's Fishing Frenzy.name: Rapala's Fishing Frenzy
Rapala's Fishing Frenzy.summary:
BATTLE TROPHY FISH BEYOND BELIEF!

Travel to the World's top fishing hotspots and put your angling skills to the ultimate test in the "hottest tournaments on water!" Hang on for the fight of your life as you experience rod-bendin', heart-poundin', fish-fightin' action!

Reel Fishing - Angler's Dream.name: Reel Fishing: Angler's Dream
Reel Fishing - Angler's Dream.summary: Gamers head off to tranquil lakes and sandy beaches in an effort to wrangle more than 40 different kinds of fish in Reel Fishing: Angler's Dream. The game takes advantage of the Wii's motion-sensitive controls to let players cast and reel just as they would in real life, and each of the 40 fish species fights and flees like its real-world counterpart. When gamers are satisfied with their catch they can head back to the lodge, where the Fishing Master doles out expert advice and showcases the new equipment players have earned. Angler's Dream also strays into life development sim territory, because the lodge includes a number of aquariums where gamers can care for and rear their most prized catches. The ultimate goal for solo players is to track down the rare and elusive Legendary Fish, but those looking for multiplayer action can join up to three friends in the competitive "Versus" mode.
